entries.title: Ask HN: 16-hour work week jobs?
entries.author: thy_inquisitor
entries.excerpt: I have had an extremely good experience doing a 4 hour per day, 4 day per week job, in which I was mainly doing a greenfield project for a startup company. Hands down, it was best work experience I have ever had. entries.guide_zh: 体验过每周工作十六小时后，发帖者寻求类似岗位并分享自己的感受。

entries.title: Ask HN Mods: Why Do You Completely Change What Users Submit?

entries.title: Ask HN: Did you get "never have to work again rich" through software?
entries.author: hoodoof
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Did you get "never have to work again rich" through software?
entries.excerpt: How did you do it? What did it feel like when you first realised it was going to be true that you would never have to work again if you didn't want to? How old were you? What was it specifically that made the cash that ended up in your pocket? Do you feel happy in your life?
